Fang-Ma Proposition 13.9 requires one edge e for which xi_e triangleleft C_delete on the entire distinguished component. Allowing the edge to depend on the component point does not produce a single polynomial decomposition C_M=C_delete(w_e+1)-xi_e and therefore does not imply C-Garding. No overlap certificate can repair this quantifier mismatch without first yielding one global edge.
